# The One For All (TOFA)

> TOFA is a South African RegTech platform for transport, logistics and industrial businesses. It combines fleet management (TMS), HR and HSEQ compliance in one system, built around South African law: RTMS (SANS 1395), dangerous goods transport, OHSA, BCEA leave, COIDA and POPIA.

Built by Madz Ventures (Pty) Ltd, Johannesburg, South Africa. Founded by Devan Govender, a former operations manager in bulk dangerous goods transport.

## Who it is for
- South African transport operators, including dangerous goods (LPG, fuel, chemicals) and tanker fleets
- SMEs with 20 to 300 employees that need HR, leave and compliance records in one place
- Fitment centres and parts businesses (brakes, parts counter, workshop job cards)

## Modules
- Fleet & TMS: trips, dispatch, routes, fuel, vehicle and driver compliance with expiry alerts, axle load, OBC/telematics events, invoicing per contract
- Daily vehicle checks: drivers complete company checklists on their phone (e.g. dangerous goods inspection); a failed critical item marks the vehicle not fit for use and alerts the fleet manager
- HR: employee files, POPIA-separated sensitive data, BCEA leave balances, line-manager leave approval, staff self-service, disciplinary, grievances, IR cases, HR audit trail and reports
- HSEQ: incidents, CAPA, risk register, PPE matrix and issue register, supplier and contractor compliance (OHSA s37(2), COID letters of good standing, tiered document checklists, audits, site access status)
- Procurement: purchase orders, suppliers, supplier invoices
- Parts & workshop: point of sale, quotes with follow-ups, job cards, multi-depot stock, trade customer ordering portal

## Key facts
- Hosted cloud software, accessed via web browser and mobile phone
- Role-based access: staff see only their own records; managers see their teams; HR sees everyone
- Every change to employee records is logged
